EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I know this place kind of seems like
a big empty room,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but it's actually
our art museum.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I think the people in {{TAG:0005:0005:}}
appreciate fine art,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but nobody has
been donating any.
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Maybe you can help turn that
around,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}This place has
the potential to be great{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Sé que parece una sala vacía, pero

{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Non,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} cette pièce n'est pas à

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}La triste vérité, c'est que les dons

rares...
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Mais j'y pense !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Peut-être que tu

aux habitants !
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Oh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Avec ton aide, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}je

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I cittadini di {{TAG:0005:0005:}} apprezzano

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}This place is still pretty

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Nuestra colección de arte es

{{TAG:0003:0028:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Il n'y a pas grand-chose à voir dans

{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Questa collezione di opere d'arte

{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Unser Kunstmuseum ist noch immer
enttäuschend.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es wird schon besser,

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wir könnten mehr Leute wie dich

TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Burası hâlâ biraz hayal kırıklığı

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001D:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} this collection is

FR:

IT:
{{TAG:0003:001D:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} questa collezione

DE:

ES:

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Questa collezione di opere d'arte
ha reso {{TAG:0005:0005:}} una capitale

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ti siamo riconoscenti!
DE:

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}I don't think there's another

with a world-class art scene.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡No creo que exista ningún otro

{{TAG:0003:0021:}}La galerie d'art du musée
{{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} est la plus belle que

{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

DE:

Die Leute spenden einfach nichts!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I know this gallery is a bit{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}lacking

claro que tiene potencial.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Ya verás cuánto habrá mejorado

FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Cette galerie est pour l'instant loin

{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Je suis certaine qu'un jour
{{TAG:0005:0005:}} aura le plus beau musée
au monde.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Je t'invite donc à repasser à ce
moment-là.

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Lo so che questa galleria d'arte
è ancora un po'{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} carente.
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Ma ultimamente è migliorata molto.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Credo che {{TAG:0005:0005:}} diventerà
presto un centro artistico di fama
mondiale. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Dovrai tornare a visitarla!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ich weiß, unsere Kunstsammlung ist

{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ich denke, {{TAG:0005:0005:}} hat das

{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bu galerinin şu anda biraz{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}eksik

{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Does your town have a gallery like

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Sanat koleksiyonunuz
